purpose: Independent genuine Windows WMF text measurements. Original synthetic files, no application/helper renderer used as reference.

environment.pixels: top-left straight RGBA, opaque white; DIB alpha explicitly normalized
environment.gdiPlayback: Placeable header removed for SetMetaFileBitsEx, initial MM_ANISOTROPIC logical extent equals viewport extent, preserving original logical pixel size. Native files placeable240x160@96units/inch; hand fixtures96x64@96.
environment.plusPlayback: GDI+ Metafile DrawImage into destination logical rectangle on240x160 bitmap
environment.independence: Direct Windows GDI API, native WMF recording/replay, enumerated WMF replay/current position, and GDI+ playback separately measured.

contracts.name: Signed character extra
contracts.evidence: Native API extra5,-5,-40 records META_SETTEXTCHAREXTRA WORD values; replay GetTextCharacterExtra returns the same signed values. Natural spacing applies negative extra separately to characters only while advance+extra>0; otherwise that character keeps its natural advance. WiW extra-10 reduces total advance by20, leaving narrow i unchanged. ExplicitDX always adds signed extra, even when advance becomeszero ornegative.

contracts.name: Natural negative-extra endpoints
contracts.evidence: Arial-24 HH initialCP8: extra0=>42,-5=>32,-16=>10,-17/-40=>42. ii naturalCP18 and extra-5/-40 retain18. A B C natural70; extra-5=>45,-7=>49,-8=>46,-16=>54,-17/-40=>70. WiW baseline59 and extra-10=>39.

contracts.name: ExplicitDX extra and justification
contracts.evidence: Five DX20 entries with breakjustification11,count2 produce CP108,133,83,13,8,-17 for characterextra0,5,-5,-19,-20,-25 frominitial8. Native repeated pixels for fixedextra are unchanged by breakjustification0,+11,-11. This does not license applying break justification to explicitDX.

contracts.name: Justification quotient and carry
contracts.evidence: Spaces have naturaladvance7. InitialCP8, +11/count2 gives20,33,45,58,70; -11/count2 gives9,11,12,14,15. +11/count3 gives18,29,39,50,61; -11/count3 gives11,14,18,21,24. These values are consistent with a truncated1/16-pixel per-break quotient retained in fractional CP across calls, rather than exact rational remainder distribution. Negative justification clamps break advance atzero. Count0 causes no addedspacing in initialcases; count1/2/3 and totals0,11,-11,-40 were measured. The fixedpoint interpretation is inference from these sampled endpoints, not inspection of Windows internals.

contracts.name: Saved and reset spacing state
contracts.evidence: SaveDC/RestoreDC returns CP and characterextra to the saved state and reproduces corresponding later advance; raw per-run state retained. Reset justification case resets aftertwo spaces with count2, when cumulative fractional remainder is integral; it does not independently prove reset behavior at a nonintegral carry.

contracts.name: Mapping setter timing
contracts.evidence: For sampled X1.5 mapping and totals0,+11,-11 with extra0 or5, setters before mapping versusafter mapping produce equal direct/GDI/Enum/GDI+ pixels and current positions. This sample supplies no evidence of a setter-time difference.

contracts.name: WMF high-bit stock selectors
contracts.evidence: META_SELECTOBJECT0x8008,0x800A,0x800B,0x800C returnFALSE fromPlayMetaFileRecord. Existing font Symbol/charset2 remains after highbit font selections, pixels equal prior Symbol control. Real native stock selections materialize CREATEPENINDIRECT PS_NULL or CREATEFONTINDIRECT and select real object-table slots. WMF should not inherit EMF high-bit stock index semantics.

contracts.name: Font geometry
contracts.evidence: Arial LOGFONTheight24 cellmetrics height24/ascent19/descent5/internalLeading3; height-24 metrics height27/ascent21/descent6/internalLeading3. Width12 and-12 both averagewidth12 in thissample. Escapement300 with orientation0,300,900 gives equal pixels in direct/GDI/GDI+ compatiblemode. Underline/strike cases retain full raw metrics/outputs. Rotated left/right/center UPDATECP states retained in first run.

contracts.name: WMF PDY
contracts.evidence: ETO_PDY0x2000 with exactly2*n WORDs succeeds, but paints like flagzero using only the firstn horizontal DX WORDs; the remainingwords are inert. Crucially, noDX or onlyn WORDs withPDY returnsFALSE fromPlayMetaFileRecord and paintsnothing. GDI+ still reportsDrawImage status0 despite the failed textrecord. Native ExtTextOutA ETO_PDY succeeds drawing directly, but its WMF recorder emitsno textrecord, both withDX andwithoutDX. The parser must require the full2*n payload before treating PDY as horizontal.

contracts.name: Padding and charsets
contracts.evidence: Original positive TextOut andExtTextOut odd/even strings includeA5 oddpad. Zero-pad counterparts captured in first run. Corrected55 WMF/EMF control pairs match GDI54/55; JOHAB DX mapping is a separate endpoint question below. GDI+ WMF andEMF results differ for32pairs, so equality is engine-specific and not a crossformat GDI+ pixelparity claim.

contracts.name: Rectangles, empty text, current position and nested images
contracts.evidence: Direct native clipping/opaque/empty/SaveDC/mapping samples and independent EMFcontrol fixtures retained. Corrected GDI rectangle/text control pairs equal. Embedded affine WMF/EMF parent sample is blank in GDI fallback and differs inGDI+; it does not prove native nested WMF/EMF equality.

contracts.name: Unresolved flags
contracts.evidence: Hand WMF glyphindex0x10 changes pixels instead of being ignored; exact wide-glyph string/count semantics were not established and no safe semantic implementation is inferred. RTL/numericflags not measured.

contracts.name: JOHAB DX endpoint exception
contracts.evidence: For bytes886148 (가H), DX[12,16,28], charset130, initialCP8 ends36 (=8+12+16). Characterextra5 ends46, adding once per decoded character. Charsets128/129/134/136 with equivalent two-character multibyte-plusH samples end64 (=8+12+16+28), or74 with extra5. Therefore measured JOHAB uses firstdecoded-character-count DX entries, unlike the four conventional DBCS byte-sum cases. This is a sampled contract, not a claim about all codepages.

corrections: First fixture snapshot used highbit stockNULL_PEN and Windows preserved default blackpen, producing316 borderpixels. Originalreference inputs preserved. Second snapshot creates realPS_NULL pen before background rectangle, restoring intended GDI textcontrol comparison.
First native cases queryGetTextExtent before drawing. Followup55 nativecases explicitly skip extentqueries to isolate draw/currentposition state.
Raw native recording-DC GetTextMetrics/GetCurrentPosition values may differ from display DC; direct and replay fields are separately identified.
limits: No macOS renderer or app test was run; no macOS or crossengine pixelparity assertion.
Native fonts come from hostedWindows2022 and are not copied into repository. Physical Windows UI/source-dialog visualacceptance is outside scope.
Exact API/status/pixelcontracts apply only to sampled inputs. Fixedpoint explanation is inferred from observed endpoints.
GDI+ WMF vsEMF rasterization can differ even when GDI controls match.
Glyph-index, RTL/numeric flags and unmeasured charset/transform combinations remain explicit gaps.
